skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Half-sweet Strawberry
skins.content: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Half-sweet Strawberry. Outfit Grace wears while making holiday-appropriate sweets. A simple apron meets a clash of bold black against daring red, proof that there is no contradiction between reserved expression and sincere intent.
skins.quote: The sweets she makes may have a little unexpected bitterness and sourness, but the feelings she wishes to share are always sweet as sugar.
